_comment: Reference only. `codex/install.py` GENERATES the real ~/.codex/hooks.json with your interpreter + absolute paths baked in. This shows the shape if you prefer to wire it by hand. Codex `command` is a single shell string (no args array). PreToolUse matches `apply_patch` because that is the tool name Codex reports for a file edit (Edit/Write are aliases); recall.py reads the target paths out of the patch envelope. No PostToolUse hook: Codex has no Read tool to attribute a store read to.
